However, his experience lacks direct relevance to AI accelerators, SoC/IP modeling, or deep-learning workload optimization. His education and skills do not align closely with the Principal-level hardware-software co-design requirements, though his technical depth and problem-solving skills are notable.

concerns: No direct experience with AI accelerators, SoC/IP modeling, or deep-learning workload optimization
